answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in proof-of-personhood anchored to a physical jetty, where each registered agent stakes a bonded deposit tied to a verifiable hardware plume signature. Identity issuance flows through a crystal-clear attestation ledger that binds stake to unique biometric entropy, so cloning an identity forces duplicate collateral. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
